_about: Machine-readable seed ledger for Rosetta vNext. Active PackManifest v2 records are separate from directional ProjectionManifest v2 records.

A pack freezes native vocabulary and exact source custody only. A projection owns target choice, mapping normalization, invariant, loss, dependencies, rival, discriminator, kill criterion, round trip, and cells.
The four legacy teleology and ontology collision examples survive under two inverse-but-independent projections. Their incompatible local row numbers kill bare Lx identities, not either native pack.
Changed pack meaning creates a new pack version. Changed mapping meaning creates a new projection revision whose supersedes_ref retains the prior revision.
PackManifest v1 and ProjectionManifest v1 remain historical/read-only inputs; they cannot be registered as active seed records in this v3 ledger.
Evidence tier symbols identify distinct warrant kinds, not positions in a total order. Every changed fact_tier or mapping_tier needs its own receipt-backed, externally attested transition.

packs.description: Eleven typed terms in the pure Soul Loop feedback grammar; this is a graph, not a seven-rung ladder.

native_term_definitions.label: Available actual state
native_term_definitions.description: X_t, the available actual state entering selection.

native_term_definitions.label: Represented alternatives
native_term_definitions.description: Ω_t, merely possible counterfactual contents represented by actual model tokens.

native_term_definitions.label: Fallible model
native_term_definitions.description: M_t, the present actual modeled-future token and territory estimate.

native_term_definitions.label: Usable actual means
native_term_definitions.description: V_t, physically and operationally usable D4 means.

native_term_definitions.label: Authorization assessment
native_term_definitions.description: U_t, authorization and normative assessment kept separate from causal occurrence.

native_term_definitions.label: Selection policy
native_term_definitions.description: G_t, the actual policy or weights used to choose.

native_term_definitions.label: Selection function
native_term_definitions.description: χ_t, the function producing an action or null plus a commitment receipt.

native_term_definitions.label: Commitment receipt
native_term_definitions.description: q_t, recording option, actor, means, authorization, expected consequence, and attempt, refusal, or unavailability.

native_term_definitions.label: Environment transition
native_term_definitions.description: K_t, other agents, physical constraints, noise, and conditions outside the selector.

native_term_definitions.label: Outcome receipt
native_term_definitions.description: r_(t+1), the environment-issued observation kept distinct from commitment.

native_term_definitions.label: Model-policy revision
native_term_definitions.description: Loop update of M and G from commitment and outcome receipts, including a legitimate null update.
